review_evidence: README describes an outdated but concrete Lean Blueprint example whose demo connects definitions and theorems to generated documentation.
LeanBlueprintExample/Basic.lean defines one, two, and proves one_plus_one_eq_two, while Exe/Decls.lean implements nontrivial project/declaration URL extraction utilities in Lean.

Although the repository is an example/template and contains a build lakefile, its Lean files contain unique definitions, theorem statements, and tooling interfaces; FILTER-011/FILTER-008 do not justify hard exclusion.
summary: Retain all LeanBlueprintExample primary files; the example and tooling modules contain actual declarations and a checked theorem.
